decision: Continue the 0.001 run to a 20,000-update budget with the existing validation-driven scheduler; preserve the lower-rate continuation for comparison. Results at 2,000 updates are close: higher rate has slightly better SI-SDRi, lower rate slightly better ESTOI and distortion proxy. This is an exploratory resource allocation, not evidence that one learning rate is superior.
final_selection: Not frozen; fresh reserved test remains unscored.
